description: Authenticates the domain so Portal can send a club's or business page's email from the owner's own address. Adds the email provider's (Brevo) domain verification TXT record and two DKIM CNAME records; the optional dmarc group adds a monitoring-only DMARC record for domains that have none.
variableDescription: %code%: account verification code (hex), written as brevo-code:%code%. %dkim%: the domain's DKIM label at Brevo, the domain with dots as dashes (e.g. example-com), used in b1.%dkim%.dkim.brevo.com and b2.%dkim%.dkim.brevo.com.
